text: No. P-45021/112/2020-PP (BE-II)/024 Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Public Procurement Section) Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi Dated the 19 th Mar, 2025 Registration Certificate to M/s Schlumberger Asia Services Limited. The undersigned is directed to refer to the application No Nil dated 29.09.2023 of M/s Schlumberger Asia Services Limited seeking registration in accordance with Department of Expenditure Order (Public Procurement No.4) No. F. 7/10/2021-PPD dated 23.02.2023 and to convey that competent authority has approved grant of registration on the following terms and conditions to the entity mentioned below: Name of the Entity Mis Schlumberger Asia Services Limited Registered Address/ 26th Floor, Three Exchange Square, 8 Connaught Correspondence Address Place, Central, Hong Kong Correspondence Address in India: 8th floor, Tower C, Building No . 10 , DLF Cyber City Phase 11 , Gurgaon 122002 Contact Person: Sshrey Gupta, Email id : Sgupta@slb.com. Telephone no: +91 9899531045 ltem/s for which registration Supply of goods or services or works contract in is granted connection with its oilfield operations in India which include following segments : Validity of registration i. Provision of products, chemicals and equipment for Oil & Gas operations i i. Drilling Services ii i. Well oilfield services including testing , cementing, coiled tubing, stimulations and sand control etc iv. Well completion services including well testing and artificial lift v. Integrated oilfield services catering from pore to pipeline in the O&G deep water and shallow water sector vi. Open-hole and Cased-hole wireline logging . vii. Reservoir characterization and production. viii. 'Oil & Gas related Software Services' which are integral part of hiring packages re lated to above 7 categories 03 years from the date of issue of this letter, i.e ., 1am March, 2028 No. P-45021/112/2020-PP (BE-II)/024 Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Public Procurement Section) Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi Dated the 19 th Mar, 2025 Registration Certificate to M/s Schlumberger Asia Services Limited.
